title: MZ GabeMZ Smart Followers: Ignores Through ON

posts.author: Bazinioli
posts.body:
The title. Basically, I'm using
this
plugin which makes followers move a bit more naturally, but I'm realising that it completely ignores "Through ON" being enabled, which means Followers get stuck on collision in cutscenes and such that make use of Through.

I'm referring to the "Through On" you can turn on in Set Move Route or when you hold Left Ctrl on the keyboard. It disables your collision when it's on.
(the option in Set Move Route)
You can see I held Ctrl to walk through these trees here, and my followers, with the script on, do not walk through them and instead just get stuck on the trees. Regular Followers (without the plugin) don't have this issue and will walk through walls with you when Ctrl is held.
Then, in the case of this cutscene, I had an invisible player start up where you see the followers, and walk down to make the camera pan. Then when made visible, though, it's clear that the followers got stuck and did not follow like they should
(the event page for said cutscene)
This is a bug or oversight of some kind in the plugin itself, it doesn't make sense for the Followers to ignore Through ON being enabled

No, it doesn't happen when it's off because this is a bug WITH the plugin. It is the GabeMZ Smart Followers plugin itself not working correctly.
I made a quick video demonstrating the problem.
You can see that the Smart Followers (with plugin) completely ignore Through ON being enabled for the player, which causes them to get stuck on collision in cutscenes. This does not happen in base RMMZ with its normal followers, who correctly continue to follow the player through walls and such.
I would like if someone could fix this bug if possible. There's no benefit to Followers ignoring Through ON and it's a hindrance to have to work around it
